notes:
Lead source: inbound website form (free credits). SMB ecomm platform selling subscriptions + customer support chat bot. Early discovery — wants hosted_api (fast onboarding).

Highlights / quotes: "We want decent answers for product issues but can trade a bit of language quality to hit our budget." - Head of Product.

Model selection questions from call: prefer details on Llama/Mistral/Qwen variants and which to pick for short conversational flows (~100-300 tokens) vs product recommendation (longer context). Asked specifically: 
- Llama2-13b vs Mistral-Instruct-7B vs Qwen-7B: delta in hallucination & instruction-following?
- Can we start on smaller cheaper models and route to higher-quality only for escalation? Cost calculator examples?
- Any recommended quantized variants for hosted_api to reduce cost but preserve latency?

Performance targets: median latency <250ms for short chat turns, p95 <600ms; throughput 20-40 reqs/s for peak. Budget: finance set a soft cap of $800/mo during POC. Token patterns: short instruction+user message ~80 tokens, responses 40-180 tokens.

Current tests run by customer: trial used hosted_api endpoints with llama-2-13b-q4_variant and mistral-instruct-7b. Observations: Mistral-instruct felt snappier at equivalent latency but occasional terse completions on edge cases; Llama chain-of-thought more verbose and better at multi-step troubleshooting. Also ran qwen-7b for reranking tests — cheaper per-token but slightly worse on long-tail product nuance.

Requested from Redwood:
- Example routing policy: start with qwen-7b for normal queries, escalate to mistral-instruct when confidence low or user asks follow-up more than 2 turns, fall back to llama-13b for critical troubleshooting.
- Concrete cost/latency numbers for hosted variants (qwen-7b, mistral-instruct-7b, llama-2-13b, and qwen-14b if available).
- Guidance on streaming vs non-streaming for UI perceived latency.
- Short checklist for SOC2/audit logs and SSO integration steps.

POC plan (high level):
- Week 1: enable hosted_api keys, import prompt set, run baseline A/B (qwen-7b vs mistral-instruct-7b).
- Week 2: measure latency vs cost, add escalation routing, capture examples where quality gaps matter.
- Week 3: refine prompts and caching; evaluate fallback policies and finalize recommended model mix.

Notes/Follow-ups: SE to provide 3-tier recommendation (cost-first, balance, quality-first) with sample token burn calc and expected monthly spend at 10k monthly active users. Legal asked for SOC2 doc link (send security FAQ). Finance may ask to throttle LLM usage by route if costs spike.

Stubs/links: pricing deck + sample prompt set on Drive (see linked_drive_docs). Gmail thread contains trial logs. Jira INF-2147 opened to track model routing POC engineering questions.
